courses.title: MongoDB Administrator + Developer Training & Certification
courses.description: Master MongoDB from beginner to advanced level. Learn MongoDB development, database administration, security, performance optimization, replication, backup and recovery, sharding, MongoDB Atlas and production-ready deployments.

includes.title: MongoDB Development
includes.description: Learn CRUD operations, queries, aggregation, data modeling and transactions.

includes.title: MongoDB Administration
includes.description: Configure MongoDB servers, users, roles, authentication and database operations.

includes.title: MongoDB Security
includes.description: Learn authentication, authorization, RBAC, TLS and database security best practices.

includes.title: Performance Optimization
includes.description: Optimize queries, indexes, execution plans and database performance.

includes.title: High Availability
includes.description: Configure replica sets, failover and highly available MongoDB environments.

includes.title: Backup & Recovery
includes.description: Learn mongodump, mongorestore, backup strategies and disaster recovery.

includes.title: MongoDB Atlas
includes.description: Deploy and manage MongoDB databases in MongoDB Atlas cloud.

includes.title: Hands-on Projects
includes.description: Build e-commerce, banking, replica set and production MongoDB projects.

certificationGuide.title: MongoDB Certification Preparation
certificationGuide.description: Prepare for MongoDB Developer and Database Administrator certification paths with practical exercises, projects and real-world scenarios.
